chunks: God will surely lead them to a place with which they will be gratified. Verily God is all-knowing and forbearing.

key_terms.يَرْضَوْنَهُ: they will be satisfied/gratified with it

ai.seo_question: What does God promise to admit the believers into in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Madkhul al-Mardhi* (the place of satisfaction), interpreted not only as Paradise but also as the station of proximity to God achieved through the Ahl al-Bayt. The mention of *Al-Halim* (The Forbearing) highlights God's patience in granting believers time to attain this high status without immediate retribution for their shortcomings. This reinforces the theological principle that divine mercy and knowledge work in tandem to guide the faithful to ultimate contentment.
